question: In Ancient India, which of the following dynasties was empowered in Deccan by Gautamiputra Satakarni?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satavahana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Satavahana dynasty was an Indian dynasty based in the Deccan region.

• Gautamiputra Satakarni was one of the most powerful rulers of the Satavahana dynasty.

• He reigned in the early 2nd century CE and significantly expanded the Satavahana territory.

• Gautamiputra Satakarni is known for his military conquests and his efforts to revive Vedic traditions and culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Satavahana Dynasty**

• The Satavahana dynasty, also known as the Andhras, ruled the Deccan region of India from approximately the 1st century BCE to the 3rd century CE.

• Their capital was Pratishthana (modern-day Paithan in Maharashtra).

• The dynasty is noted for its contribution to Indian art, culture, and trade. They played a significant role in promoting Buddhism.

• The Satavahanas issued the first known Indian coins with portraits of their rulers, which influenced later Indian coinage.

• **Gautamiputra Satakarni**

• Gautamiputra Satakarni is often regarded as the greatest of the Satavahana kings.

• His reign is marked by the successful defense of the Deccan region against foreign invasions, particularly from the Sakas (Western Kshatrapas).

• He is celebrated for his revival of Vedic sacrifices and his efforts to restore the traditional social order.

• His achievements are recorded in the Nasik inscription by his mother, Gautami Balashri.

• **Deccan Region**

• The Deccan region refers to the large plateau in western and southern India, bounded by the Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats.

• This region has historically been a significant center of Indian culture and political power, with various dynasties ruling over it.

• The Satavahanas, Chalukyas, Rashtrakutas, and Vijayanagara Empire are some of the notable dynasties that ruled the Deccan.

• The Deccan is known for its unique contributions to Indian architecture, literature, and art.
